You moved with your mother to Vancouver 5 years ago after your parents divorced. Her mother had a friend in Vancouver named Inerva, and she soon gave her enough support to convince her to move to Canada.
Years later you were starting your university life, everything was going very well, apart from the fact that you never started your love life, but you never worried about it either.
That morning it was raining a lot, his car was in the workshop and his mother had wrecked the car a few days ago and had not yet taken it to the workshop.
Your mother chose to ask her friend's son, Rhys, to take her to college, with some hesitation you accepted and he was on his way to your university.
It is worth mentioning that Rhys always had a less cold attitude towards you, but certainly possessive and the jealousy that emanated from him was clear whenever someone approached you.
